{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("First few values of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head(10))

# Check for any non-numeric patterns
print("\nUnique values in revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].unique())

# Confirm if any revenue strings contain commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nRows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check for the known QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"\nNumber of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")"}
